SITUATION
A&E assessment, 01 April 2025. PERSON_828c1a98, accompanied by adult child, with 18-hour history of central abdominal pain migrating to the right lower quadrant. Nausea and loss of appetite; no diarrhoea. Pain worse on movement.

BACKGROUND
Usual GP record reviewed. No previous abdominal surgery reported. Paracetamol taken at home with limited effect. No known drug allergy documented.

ASSESSMENT
Alert, uncomfortable but haemodynamically stable. BP 120/80 mmHg, pulse 96, temperature 37.8°C, SpO₂ 98% on air. Abdomen soft, focal RIF tenderness with guarding and positive percussion tenderness; no palpable mass. Chest clear, heart sounds normal.

Bloods: neutrophilia and raised CRP; renal function acceptable. Urinalysis negative for blood and nitrites. Pregnancy testing not clinically indicated. CT abdomen/pelvis: inflamed appendix with periappendiceal inflammatory change, no collection or perforation.

ACTION / PRIORITIES
Cannula inserted. IV fluids commenced, analgesia with paracetamol. Intravenous co-amoxiclav given following surgical discussion. Nil by mouth pending theatre review. General surgery referral accepted by [ORGANIZATION].

PLAN
Admit under surgery for laparoscopic appendicectomy assessment. Escalate for increasing pain, sepsis or haemodynamic change. Handover completed to PERSON_325f2eaa, clinician at [ORGANIZATION]. Patient and adult child updated; questions answered. Contact details confirmed in EHR. Documented at 01 April 2025 for [AGE] y/o.
